alert: Checkout latency spike and 504s after v2.12.0 deploy
logs: 2026-08-03T14:32:11Z checkout-7d8d9 HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
2026-08-03T14:32:14Z nginx-02 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header
root_cause: A deploy increased checkout worker concurrency without increasing the Hikari connection pool; Postgres connections were exhausted.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart checkout pods
Roll back worker concurrency and raise Hikari maximumPoolSize after checking Postgres headroom

resolution_steps: Confirm active Postgres sessions remain below 80%

alert: Checkout address validation failures after Friday config publish
logs: 2026-08-07T10:12:42Z checkout-56df shipping-provider config key ADDRESS_API_URL is empty
root_cause: Friday configuration publish omitted the production address validation endpoint.

attempted_fixes.step: Retry failed checkouts
Restore revision 883 and add required-key validation

alert: Login errors from expired mTLS certificate
logs: 2026-08-11T03:44:06Z auth-6f4b TLS handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
2026-08-11T03:46:00Z cert-manager renewal job last success 89d ago
root_cause: The internal auth mTLS certificate renewal job had no alert and allowed the certificate to expire.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart auth pods
Renew certificate and reload the secret

alert: Search API pod restarts after six days uptime
root_cause: An unbounded query cache leaked memory until the service had roughly six days of uptime.

attempted_fixes.step: Increase pod memory limit
Cap query cache entries and deploy the cache eviction patch

alert: Card authorization failures from Redis READONLY errors
logs: 2026-08-14T17:16:24Z payments-77c8 RedisCommandExecutionException: READONLY You can't write against a read only replica
root_cause: Payments retained the old Redis primary endpoint after Sentinel failover.

attempted_fixes.step: Flush Redis client connections
Update Sentinel discovery configuration and restart only the connection pool

logs: 2026-08-17T14:41:03Z checkout-9c8fb HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
2026-08-17T14:42:10Z postgres-01 FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved
root_cause: The same post-deploy worker-concurrency change exhausted the checkout Hikari pool and Postgres connection budget.

attempted_fixes.step: Scale checkout replicas from 8 to 12
Revert concurrency flag and set pool cap to 35

resolution_steps: Add deploy preflight against Postgres connection budget

alert: Checkout tax calculation unavailable after Friday config change
root_cause: A Friday config revision changed the tax secret path without moving the secret.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart vault-agent sidecars
Restore the prior config revision and validate secret references

alert: Inventory writes blocked by migration lock
logs: 2026-08-24T06:06:39Z postgres-02 ERROR: canceling statement due to lock timeout
2026-08-24T06:06:42Z inventory-76c9 UPDATE inventory SET reserved=reserved+1 timeout
2026-08-24T06:02:01Z migrator ALTER TABLE inventory ADD COLUMN supplier_sku
root_cause: An online migration used an AccessExclusiveLock during the morning inventory batch.

attempted_fixes.step: Increase application statement timeout
Cancel the migration and rerun it with concurrent/index-safe phases

resolution_steps: Terminate only the stuck migration session

alert: Token validation latency after DNS resolver failure
root_cause: Node-local DNS forwarded JWKS lookups to an unreachable upstream resolver.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart auth service
Fail over CoreDNS upstream and clear the negative DNS cache

resolution_steps: Verify JWKS refresh and login success

alert: Search API OOMKilled after 6.4 days uptime
root_cause: The query-cache memory leak persisted in a canary pool after the cache eviction patch missed one deployment template.

attempted_fixes.step: Roll pods one at a time
Apply cache cap to the canary template and reduce existing cache pressure

resolution_steps: Add template parity check in CI

root_cause: Settlement consumers were underscaled during a broker disk-I/O slowdown and rebalance churn.

attempted_fixes.step: Increase max.poll.interval.ms
Scale consumers and throttle the noisy broker partition

resolution_steps: Scale settlement consumer group from 6 to 12

alert: Inventory API 502s from upstream connection resets
logs: 2026-09-01T08:50:14Z nginx-03 connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream
2026-09-01T08:50:16Z inventory-5c7db startup probe failed: database migrations pending
root_cause: Inventory API was marked ready before its startup migration check completed.

attempted_fixes.step: Reload nginx
Correct the readiness probe and roll back the premature deployment

alert: Checkout latency spike after v2.14.2 deploy
logs: 2026-09-03T14:39:21Z checkout-57fd9 HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
2026-09-03T14:40:03Z postgres-01 FATAL: too many clients already
root_cause: A reintroduced checkout worker-concurrency default exhausted Hikari and Postgres connections immediately after deployment.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart all checkout pods
Roll back worker setting, enforce pool cap, and add deploy guard

resolution_steps: Block deploy when projected DB sessions exceed 80%

root_cause: A partner batch used a shared CIDR rate-limit bucket and exhausted it for normal users.

attempted_fixes.step: Raise global rate limit
Assign the partner a dedicated client bucket and replay allowed requests

alert: Payment callback 502s after upstream certificate rotation
logs: 2026-09-08T11:15:10Z payments-77c8 SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path building failed
root_cause: The payment gateway truststore lacked the partner's new intermediate certificate.

attempted_fixes.step: Retry callbacks
Import the new intermediate chain and reload truststore

alert: Checkout promo errors after Friday flag rollout
logs: 2026-09-11T09:27:22Z checkout-77dd feature flag PROMO_V3=true but promo endpoint undefined
2026-09-11T09:28:40Z checkout-77dd TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined
root_cause: A Friday feature-flag rollout enabled PROMO_V3 before its required endpoint configuration.

attempted_fixes.step: Scale checkout pods
Disable PROMO_V3 and restore validated configuration bundle

alert: Search pods OOMKilled after six days
root_cause: A cache eviction worker regression after six days allowed the search query cache to grow without bound.

attempted_fixes.step: Raise JVM max heap
Roll back the eviction-worker regression and cap query-cache entries

alert: Checkout latency spike, 504 errors after 14:30 deploy
logs: 2026-09-16T14:31:19Z checkout-89cdf HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
2026-09-16T14:32:08Z postgres-01 FATAL: too many clients already
root_cause: Deploy v2.14.3 raised checkout concurrency and exhausted the Hikari/Postgres connection budget, repeating the post-deploy pool-exhaustion pattern.

attempted_fixes.step: Restart checkout pods
